title: You are Peace
cue: "O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace…"
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
transliteration: Allaahumma antas-salaamu waminkas-salaam, tabaarakta yaa dhal-jalaali wal-ikraam
translation: O Allah, You are Peace and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honour.

witnesses.name: shamela
witnesses.ref: Sahih Muslim, ed. Muhammad Fu’ad Abd al-Baqi, hadith 591: https://shamela.ws/book/1727/1275

provenance.note: The printed Abd al-Baqi text on Shamela has يا ذا الجلال; hadith-api has ذا الجلال without يا. We follow the printed edition.

when: After the prayer, following the three requests for forgiveness
